title: Improving LLM Final Representations with Inter-Layer Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2603.22665v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The standard in LLM-based prediction is to use the final-layer representation as the input to a downstream predictor. However, intermediate layers may encode complementary task-relevant signals. Existing approaches therefore either search for the best layer for each task or apply expensive attention-based mechanisms to learn inter-layer aggregation. In this work, we first show that such complexity is unnecessary: a lightweight Graph Neural Network over a fully connected graph of LLM layers is more efficient and achieves significantly stronger predictive performance than existing approaches. We then introduce the Cayley-Encoder, which further improves both efficiency and predictive performance by replacing the fully connected graph with a Cayley graph over SL(2, Zn). translated_title: 利用层间几何结构改进大语言模型的最终层表示
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）进行预测的标准做法是将最终层的表示作为下游预测器的输入。然而，中间层可能编码了互补的、与任务相关的信号。因此，现有方法要么为每个任务搜索最佳的层，要么采用代价高昂的基于注意力的机制来学习层间聚合。在本工作中，我们首先证明这种复杂性是不必要的：在由LLM各层构成的完全连接图上使用一个轻量级的图神经网络（GNN），不仅比现有方法更高效，还能取得显著更强的预测性能。随后，我们提出了Cayley编码器（Cayley-Encoder），通过用定义在SL(2, Zn)上的凯莱图替换完全连接图，进一步提升了效率与预测性能。这些凯莱图提供了一种数学上有依据的拓扑结构，具有稀疏、构造上规则且低直径的特点，从而使各层之间能够进行有效的通信。
tldr: 本文提出用轻量级图神经网络聚合大语言模型各层信息，并进一步设计基于SL(2,Zn)凯莱图的Cayley编码器，以稀疏、规则且低直径的数学拓扑替代昂贵的注意力机制，在提升效率的同时显著增强下游预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a lightweight GNN over LLM layer graphs outperforms costly attention-based inter-layer aggregation, and further introduces the Cayley-Encoder, which leverages sparse, regular, low-diameter Cayley graphs over SL(2, Zn) to improve both efficiency and predictive performance.
